# outputs/mhw/event_reports/

Per-year event listing CSVs nested by region (`north/`, `central/`, `south/`).

## Purpose

Human-readable yearly event reports derived from the Hobday catalogues.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/generate_mhw_reports.py`.

## Upstream / Downstream

`outputs/mhw/catalogue/` → yearly report folders → manual review / supplements to annual statistics.
